kind: game lore (fiction; the game's own places and Wild Rides)
title: Nobody has ever seen who clears these roads
lines: In this town, every road is clear by five a.m. And nobody has ever seen who does it.
The farmer says her cows go quiet right before it passes.
The guy at the junkyard swears it was a monster truck.
Up at the old castle, they say it had wings.
Out at the ranch, people saw lights in the sky.
The mayor put up a reward. Nobody has ever claimed it.
